status_reason: WP7 preregistration draft, frozen-pending-owner-gate (see freeze). The paradigm module is not implemented yet (spec doc item I3), and the Phase 1 gate is not signed off. Gating tolerances are judgements (verified:false), so the best achievable verdict is PASS_PROVISIONAL.

freeze.rule: Every field except status, status_reason, freeze and calibration.result is frozen. tests/test_wp7_graph_policy.py recomputes frozen_content_sha256 and fails on any edit. Results are recorded as they come out, without retuning. Any change after a real-graph run is a new spec id (suffix -2) with an amendment block, and the earlier result stays on record.
freeze.owner_gate: The owner flips status draft -> preregistered in a commit that changes nothing else, after (a) the Phase 1 gate is signed off, (b) implementation items I1-I4 of the spec doc are merged and their synthetic plumbing tests pass, and (c) the sidecar files named here exist with the recorded hashes.

summary: E0: is the mushroom body in a learnable regime without plasticity? KC responding fraction per odour and OCT/MCH active-set overlap on the P4 primary graph (KC->KC fast weight zero, DPM GABA). Decides whether E1 runs. Four comparison graph variants are run with the same spec and reported.

V2_primary.role: primary: gated; decides whether E1 runs

V0_released.note: plain v3 weights (KC->KC released, DPM silent as predicted dopamine)

V4_calyx_kept_dpm_gaba.note: BLOCKED until the calyx sidecar exists (item I1); its sha256 is recorded in the receipt and in the graph identity

backend: cuda on the GPU host (auto falls back to CPU); recorded in the receipt

stimulus.block_order: seed even: air, OCT, MCH; seed odd: air, MCH, OCT
stimulus.reset: network starts from rest once per seed (runner.reset); no reset between blocks, so every block sees the state the previous one left
stimulus.literature_match: Honegger 2011 and Turner 2008 score KC responses over a ~2 s odour window

encoder.presentation: bilateral: both antennae receive the same odour (contralateral_fraction is therefore irrelevant)
encoder.note: The DoOR table, r_max_hz, noise_sd, spontaneous rates and drive inversion are exactly those of the named file at the named sha256. A run whose referenced file hashes differently is refused by the paradigm (implementation item I3).

decoder.rule: none: E0 records neural activity only; no behavioural choice is decoded

measures.kc_responder: a KC responds to an odour iff (spikes in the 2-s stimulus window) - (spikes in the 2-s pre window of the same block) >= 2. Threshold is a declared judgement (NOT VERIFIED against a published criterion).
measures.kc_responding_fraction: responders / all KCs (4,064), per odour; also per side (KC_L, KC_R), reported
measures.kc_overlap_OCT_MCH: |R_OCT & R_MCH| / min(|R_OCT|, |R_MCH|): the stricter of the common overlap definitions (larger than Jaccard). Undefined if either set is empty; an undefined seed makes the overlap gate INCONCLUSIVE, it is never dropped.
measures.reported_rates: mean rate over each window for PPL101, PPL102, PPL103 (spontaneous = air block, evoked = OCT and MCH stimulus windows), MBON11 and MBON12 evoked, DPM and APL; written to paradigm_extra, not gated

seed_role: encoder per-cell noise; each seed is one simulated fly receiving air, OCT and MCH

analysis.note: the harness bootstrap over seeds; "behaviour" here holds the neural gates of E0

gates.claim: The fraction of KCs responding to OCT lies between 1 % and 20 % (95 % CI inside).
gates.basis: Honegger 2011 (READ in design doc): ~5-6 % per odour on average, up to 17 %; Turner 2008 (READ): 6 +/- 5 % by single-cell recording. The 1-20 % band is a judgement around those values.

gates.claim: The fraction of KCs responding to MCH lies between 1 % and 20 % (95 % CI inside).
The OCT and MCH responder sets overlap by less than 60 % (95 % CI upper bound).
gates.basis: Hige 2015 Neuron (READ in design doc) measured 30-33 % OCT/MCH KC overlap; the overlap definition used there was not checked against this one; 60 % is a judgement.

reported.claim: per-side KC responding fraction, OCT, left (reported)
reported.basis: KCab-s annotation asymmetry (design doc §1.2) makes the side split worth reporting

reported.claim: per-side KC responding fraction, OCT, right (reported)
per-side KC responding fraction, MCH, left (reported)
per-side KC responding fraction, MCH, right (reported)

decision_rule: Harness rule (validation/harness.py VERDICTS) on the V2_primary variant. E1 runs only if E0 on V2_primary is PASS or PASS_PROVISIONAL. If V2_primary fails, E1 does not run, the failure is recorded, and no other variant is promoted to primary without a new spec version with an amendment. Verdicts of the comparison variants are reported and never decide anything.

turner2008.citation: Turner GC, Bazhenov M, Laurent G (2008) Olfactory representations by Drosophila mushroom body neurons. J Neurophysiol 99:734-746
values_read: KC response probability 6 +/- 5%, n = 71; responders fire 4.9 +/- 3.0 (alpha'/beta') and 2.2 +/- 1.2 (alpha/beta) spikes, window 0-2 s, odour 1:1000

hige2015neuron.citation: Hige T, Aso Y, Modi MN, Rubin GM, Turner GC (2015) Heterosynaptic plasticity underlies aversive olfactory learning in Drosophila. Neuron 88:985
values_read: MBON-gamma1pedc>alpha/beta OCT response 118 +/- 8.3 spikes before and 24 +/- 7.4 after pairing (n = 7); MCH 110 +/- 11 -> 83 +/- 14; counted 0-1.4 s, spontaneous subtracted; spontaneous rates not reported

honegger2011.citation: Honegger KS, Campbell RAA, Turner GC (2011) Cellular-resolution population imaging reveals robust sparse coding in the Drosophila mushroom body. J Neurosci 31(33):11772-11785
values_read: about 5 % of KCs active per odour on average, up to 17 % for some odours; KCs fire typically 5 to 10 spikes per odour (as quoted in docs/design/mb_learning.md)

census.citation: scripts/mb_circuit_census.py output, docs/design/mb_circuit_census.json (MaleCNS v1.0, sha256-checked against data-provenance/malecns_v1/source.lock.json)
values_read: 4,064 KCs; 2 DPM (predicted dopamine); KC->KC 642,933 edges / 1,153,845 contacts; DPM->KC 4,082 edges / 32,795 contacts; primary plastic set 86,981 synapses, 18,799 (edge, compartment) pairs, 16,250 engine edges
